title.en: EU DPP Textile Associated Materials Ontology

description.en: Ontology module for non-textile components, packaging materials, textile chemical substances and controlled chemical classifications associated with textile products. Fibre composition remains in Textile Core, while regulatory qualification and occurrence of substances of concern belong to the Textile SoC module.

labels.en: EU DPP Textile Associated Materials Ontology

comments.en: The module reuses soc:Substance for substance identity and the MAT MaterialOfComposition pattern where material occurrences are needed. It does not classify a substance as a substance of concern.
